HediffDef.label: retroviral Wraith humanization
HediffDef.description: Retroviral therapy is suppressing the Iratus-derived Wraith phenotype in this individual. The same pawn remains underneath the treatment, but Wraith metabolism, regeneration, host-cultivation traits and telepathy are biologically suppressed. A separate suppression injection must be given roughly daily; if maintenance lapses, the recorded Wraith biology returns.
